responsibility: This machine description provides the DFA pipeline model for the MIPS64 5K family, including both the 5kc integer-only scheduling profile and the 5kf profile with a separate floating-point pipeline. It defines the integer, multiply/divide, and FPU resources, instruction reservations, and branch/jump bypasses, allowing GCC to distinguish the single-issue base core from the partially dual-issue 5kf when tuning code generation and scheduling.
